BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Keaton, Pollet, Rude, Salahuddin, Jacobsen, Berg, Zahn, Simmons, Ormsby, and Reed

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Postsecondary Education & Workforce.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Prohibiting institutions of higher education from requiring students to live on campus.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting institutions of higher education from requiring students to live on campus; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: Public institutions of higher education may not require students to live on campus or in university residence hall facilities.
